title: Unveiling Modality Bias: Automated Sample-Specific Analysis for Multimodal Misinformation Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Ensembling three sample-specific quantification methods: 1) coarse-grained evaluation of modality benefit using Shapley values to assess uni-modal contributions; 2) medium-grained quantification of modality information flow using saliency scores to measure attention interactions; and 3) fine-grained causality analysis using counterfactual reasoning on causal inference graphs.
